subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 18 = 8 (a) He felt asleep there but a great noise woke him up. (b) It was crying for pain in leg. (c) Androcles was very much afraid and he felt sure that the beast would kill him. (d) A lion had entered the cave roaring loudly. (e) He went to the lion. (f) Then he removed a thorn from the lions paws. (g) Soon he realized that the lion was angry. (h) Once Androcle fled away from his master's house and hid himself in a forest.  Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
